6. **User-level CLAUDE.md** (`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`). It is a personal preference that applies across all of her projects, so it shouldn't be imposed on the team via repo files.

7. **Hook** (SessionStart, running the migration-status command and injecting the result). The value changes with every migration, so hardcoding it in CLAUDE.md would drift. The code and database are the source of truth, so read them at session start.

8. **Plain one-off prompt**. It is an ephemeral, single-use task, and persisting it anywhere would waste tokens in future sessions.
